text:
Genetically modified crops, whose genes have been altered in a laboratory to give them useful traits, are widely grown in some countries and banned in others. This essay will discuss the main advantages and disadvantages before explaining my own view.

On the positive side, genetically modified crops can produce higher and more reliable yields. Plants can be changed to resist pests, tolerate drought or contain extra vitamins, so farmers lose less of their harvest and need fewer chemicals. More food is then grown on the same land, which helps a growing population. A farmer who plants a drought-resistant variety, for example, may still harvest a reasonable crop in a dry year, when ordinary seed would fail. Crops improved in this way can also reduce hunger and malnutrition in poorer regions.

On the negative side, however, the long-term effects of genetically modified crops are not fully known. Modified genes could spread to wild plants, and farmers who buy patented seed each year become dependent on a few large companies. Many consumers distrust modified food, and people in some countries worry about its safety even though the evidence so far is limited. Nevertheless, these concerns can be addressed. Careful testing, independent regulation and clear labels would allow consumers to make their own choices and would help to detect problems early. Public trust is essential, because even a safe product will fail if people refuse to buy it.

In conclusion, genetically modified crops offer real benefits for food supply, but uncertainty about long-term effects and corporate control are valid concerns. On balance, I believe that they should be used cautiously, under strict testing and open information.

plan.think: Mở bài định nghĩa ngắn (gen được thay đổi để có đặc tính hữu ích) rồi báo thảo luận ưu và nhược điểm; kết luận chọn lập trường thận trọng.
Năng suất cao và ổn định hơn; chống sâu bệnh, chịu hạn, thêm vitamin; ít hoá chất; thêm lương thực trên cùng diện tích. Ví dụ nông dân trồng giống chịu hạn.
Tác động dài hạn chưa rõ; gen lan sang cây dại; nông dân lệ thuộc công ty hạt giống; người tiêu dùng nghi ngờ. Nevertheless: kiểm nghiệm cẩn thận, quy định độc lập và nhãn rõ ràng.
Dùng thận trọng dưới kiểm tra nghiêm ngặt và thông tin công khai.
